body:
GREG, 2026-11-19 about 19:29Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1616, message 9ad7e2ba), verbatim: „Absolutnie usunac ten test!!! + Kimi To jest tautologia. Zakaz tego typu testów”.
He was speaking of tests/source_file_size.rs (each src .rs file at most 2,499 physical lines), which stopped the w-808a landing (task_sync_folder_recovery.rs at 3,392 lines).
RULE (both projects):
- Remove that test, its exceptions file and its docs section.
- Do not split code mechanically just to meet such a limit.
- Do not add a replacement gate that wraps the same arbitrary metric.
- BAN: no tests that check an arbitrary structural metric (line counts, file sizes, function or file counts and the like) instead of observable behaviour. This sits beside the existing bans on text-pinning and implementation-mirroring tests.
- No new blocks. Kimi::Consultant reviews the portable wording of the ban.
Task: w-(see the removal item filed 2026-11-19).
